description: This file defines the 'EmptyCondition' class, which implements a method operation for handling the '<if-empty>' conditional logic in the MiniLang language of the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic to evaluate whether a specified field is empty and to execute sub-operations accordingly.

classes.name: EmptyCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional method operation for the '<if-empty>' element in MiniLang, evaluating whether a specified field is empty and executing corresponding sub-operations based on that condition.

classes.name: EmptyConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of 'EmptyCondition' for the '<if-empty>' element.

methods.name: EmptyCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition with XML element attributes and sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates if the specified field is empty using ObjectType.isEmpty.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the sub-operations if condition is true; otherwise, executes else sub-operations.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from contained sub-operations.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Appends a human-readable representation of the condition to the provided buffer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the '<if-empty>' element for debugging.
